summary: Special episode featuring an extended interview with Fortnox CEO Tommy Eklund discussing the company's 20-year journey, current platform with 30+ products, focus on small businesses in Sweden, growth targets to reach 700k customers by 2025, and potential for acquisitions. Includes discussion of valuation metrics and strategy.
key_takeaways: Fortnox has grown from 10k customers over 10 years to adding 15k new customers in one quarter
Company focuses on Swedish market with platform covering all aspects of running a business
Financial goals include doubling both customer count and revenue per customer by 2025
CEO emphasizes focus on customer growth over stock price management
